INSERT INTO kernel.jobs (queue, kind, payload, workspace_id, max_attempts, run_at)
        SELECT $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, coalesce($6, now())
         WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM kernel.jobs
             WHERE queue = $1 AND workspace_key = $4 AND kind = $2 AND state = 'pending'
         )
        RETURNING id
